rows.basis: Growth in gross 'Computer equipment and software' (the server/network category, later renamed 'Servers, network equipment, and software'): 60,631M − 51,250M = 9,381M. This counts all server growth, not only AI, and it is pre-generative-AI general cloud build. It is net of disposals and includes finance-lease additions outside cash capex.

Growth in gross 'Computer equipment and software': 74,961M − 60,631M = 14,330M. This counts all server growth, not only AI. It is net of disposals and includes finance-lease additions (finance lease liability rose to 17,067M), so it is not a strict subset of cash capex.

Growth in gross 'Computer equipment and software': 93,780M − 74,961M = 18,819M. This counts all server growth, AI and non-AI. It is net of disposals and includes finance-lease additions. Buildings and land (the shell) are excluded.

Growth in gross 'Computer equipment and software': 132,836M − 93,780M = 39,056M. The FY2025 balance equals the renamed 'Servers, network equipment, and software' FY2025 balance, confirming it is the same category. This counts all server growth, not only AI. It includes finance-lease additions (liability up 19.0B to 46,172M).

Growth in gross 'Servers, network equipment, and software': 215,874M − 132,836M = 83,038M. This counts all server growth, AI and non-AI. It includes finance-lease additions (liability up 20.4B to 66,594M), so the ratio to cash capex overstates the share. Buildings (+44.8B) are excluded as shell.
FY2023 MD&A: capex expected to increase 'to support growth in our cloud offerings and our investments in AI infrastructure.' This refers to total capex and gives no amount or AI share.
FY2024 MD&A: capex expected to increase to support cloud 'and our investments in AI infrastructure and training.' This refers to total capex and gives no amount or AI share.
FY2025 MD&A: will continue to invest in capex to support cloud 'and our investments in AI infrastructure and training.' This refers to total capex and gives no amount or AI share.

FY2026 MD&A: will continue to invest in capex to support cloud 'and our investments in AI training and other infrastructure.' This refers to total capex and gives no amount. Purchase commitments jumped to 194,060M (from 109,953M), signalling further build.
MD&A attributes opex and R&D increases (e.g., R&D +3.0B, 10%) to 'investments in cloud and AI engineering,' mixed with Gaming/Activision and sales. No AI amount or share is given.

MD&A attributes the opex increase (+4.9B, 7%) and R&D increase (+3.1B) to 'compute capacity, AI talent, and data,' mixed with XBOX impairment, sales and Copilot advertising. The cost of revenue increases tied to AI infrastructure are not opex. No AI amount or share is given.
FY2023 MD&A: 'investments we are making in cloud and AI infrastructure and devices will continue to increase our operating costs.' No amount is given.
FY2024 MD&A repeats that cloud and AI infrastructure investments will increase operating costs. No amount is given.
FY2025 MD&A repeats that cloud and AI infrastructure investments will increase operating costs. No amount is given.
FY2026 MD&A repeats that cloud and AI infrastructure investments will increase operating costs. No amount is given.
